description: This script sets up and tests various aspects of Git sparse checkout and sparse index functionality. It contains test sequences for setup, sparse checkout configuration, index behavior, file modifications, diff, reset, merge, conflict resolution, submodule handling, and index expansion in a Git repository environment. The script is used for verifying the correctness and consistency of sparse checkout features in Git.

methods.name: init_repos
methods.description: Initializes full, sparse-checkout, and sparse-index repositories with sparse checkout configuration.

methods.name: init_repos_as_submodules
methods.description: Initializes repositories with submodules and sets up sparse checkout in submodules.

methods.name: run_on_sparse
methods.description: Runs a given command in the sparse-checkout and sparse-index repositories.

methods.name: run_on_all
methods.description: Runs a given command in all three repositories: full, sparse-checkout, and sparse-index.

methods.name: test_all_match
methods.description: Runs a command in all repositories and verifies output matches expected.

methods.name: test_sparse_match
methods.description: Runs a command in sparse repositories and expects success.

methods.name: test_sparse_unstaged
methods.description: Verifies that certain files are unstaged in sparse repositories.

methods.name: test_sparse_checkout_set
methods.description: Sets sparse checkout directories and verifies sparse directory entries.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Wrapper to check that a test sequence succeeds.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specific lines to a file.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file for later execution.
